Hasmukh has been suspended from his job. Hasmukh’s mother invites an astrologer to her house. The astrologer gives six rings to Hasmukh. He asks Hasmukh to wear the rings which would solve all his problems.
If you are trying to view this video from a location outside India, do note this video will be made available in your territory 48 hours after its upload time
